newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia needs roads and phones, not guns-Camdessus.
newsitem.headline: Asia needs roads and phones, not guns-Camdessus.

text.p: Asian countries need to improve their infrastructure and not divert scarce resources into miltary spending, Michel Camdessus, Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), said on Friday.

"To sustain growth, a number of countries will need to improve their infrastructure, especially in transportation, telecommunications and power supply," Camdessus told an IMF-Hong Kong Monetary Authority conference on financial integration in Asia and the role of Hong Kong.
The challenge for Asian economies would be to do this without unduly straining their public finances or external position.
Some countries would need to increase transparency of their regulatory regimes and clarify pricing policies to attract substantial private investment, he said.
He called for "reduced outlay on other less productive areas such as military expenditure".
Camdessus said: "It is difficult to understand and accept that Asia is the only place in the world where military spending is increasing (as a proportion of gross domestic product)."
